2. The instant Civil Appeal No. 750 of 2006 arises pursuant to the leave granting order dated 1-12-2016 in the Civil Petition for leave to Appeal No. 1262 of 2014. The Civil Appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 16-7-2012 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1800 of 2007 discharging the. Rule and thereby affirming the judgment and decree dated 24-4-2007 and 20-3-2007 respectively passed by the learned Divisional Special Judge cum Special District Judge No. 1 Rajshahi in TA No. 239 of 2006 dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and decree dated 10-9-2006 passed in OC Suit No. 22 of 2001 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Durgapur, Rajshahi, Decreeing the suit. 

 3. The background of the instant Civil Appeal No. 750 of 2016 is that the instant respondent as plaintiff filed Other Class Suit No. 22 of 2001 before the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Durgapur, filing the Other Class Suit under Order 1. Rule 8 of the of the Code of Civil Procedure inter cilia praying for declaration to the effect that the appointment of the defendant No. 4 principle by the defendant No. 1 and the defendant No. 2 at the recommendation of the defendant No. 2 chairman on 12-4-2000 inter alia is unlawful, is intentional, inalafide, fraudulent and against the interest the appointer Defendant No. 1 college and he given that such appointment is in operative inter alia some other prayers impleading the instant appellant as defendant in the suit. Upon hearing the parties the trial Court decreed the suit by its judgment and decree dated 10-9-2006. Being aggrieved by the judgment and decree of the trial Court the defendant in the suit filed Title Appeal No. 239 of 2006 which was heard by the Court of Divisional Special Judge and 1st Court of Special District Judge, Rajshahi. The Appellate Court upon hearing the parties dismissed the appeal affirming the judgment and decree dated 24-4-2007. Being aggrieved by the judgment of the courts below the defendants in the suit filed Civil Revision No. 1800 of 2007 in which, Rule NISI was issued by the High Court Division. Upon hearing the parties the High Court Division discharged the Rule by it, judgment and order dated 16-7-2012. Being aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 16-7-2012 passed by the High Court. Division the Defendant-Appellant-Petitioner filed Civil Appeal No. 750 of 2016.
